attempts.summary: Deployed PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across node1 (initial primary), node2 and node3 (standbys) on Alpine Linux. Demonstrated primary-loss failover by stopping node1's postgres, promoting node2 to writable primary with zero committed-data loss, repointing node3 to follow node2, and rebuilding node1 as a standby of node2. Then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time node restart protocol on all three nodes (node1, node3, node2/primary), proving changed OS boot_id and full PostgreSQL/replication recovery after each restart, with quorum and data consistency preserved throughout.
